findings.location: Definition, paragraph beginning “Fix a translation-invariant unit vector,” phrase “specified unital *-subalgebra”.
findings.evidence: The item does not define the inherited algebra operations or state the closure conditions for 𝔄⊂B(H), and cites no exact supplier. The published def-qft-involutive-algebra-state defines a unital complex *-algebra but is not a dependency or reference here; the subalgebra conditions still need to be stated.
K is only assumed compact in V_+, so it may be empty; min_{b∈K}(b⁰−|b|) is then undefined. The later use is K={b}, so require K to be nonempty.

findings.location: Definition, symmetry-representation paragraph and the paragraph beginning “The positive-energy premise”.
findings.evidence: The item requires U as a representation of SL(2,C)⋉R⁴ and separately requires the joint-PVM input, whose supplier defines a translation representation U_spec:R⁴→B(H). It does not identify U((I,a)) with U_spec(a). The tube theorem is proved for U_spec, while field covariance uses the full-group U; without this restriction identity, the positive-spectrum analyticity is not connected to the field-covariant translations.

The interface requires covariance using the Poincaré pullback on Schwartz functions, but depends only on def-qft-poincare-test-action, whose definition explicitly does not assert T_g f∈S. It omits the published lem-qft-poincare-pullback-continuity-on-schwartz and supplies no local proof or preservation condition, so Φ(T_g f) is not established to be defined on the declared Schwartz domain.
